research_question: Compare the user-requested Adapter epoch2 checkpoint against primary update5400 on identical scenes unseen in either training set.
selection: Recording round-robin, recording and token order fixed by SHA256 before inference; no metric-based selection
evaluation: Unmodified official NAVSIM v1 pdm_score for both predicted trajectories, 40x0.1s simulation, common 8x0.5s output horizon, same tokens and denominator; paired recording bootstrap
checkpoint_selection: User requested Adapter epoch2 against the latest saved primary checkpoint; freeze primary update5400 before any common-panel scores. No test-driven tuning or checkpoint selection.
scope: Intermediate comparison on a fixed1024-scene navtest subset. Not full navtest. Its exposure must be declared in later benchmark reporting.
confounds: Adapter: one front camera with four observed times; joint model: four cameras at the current time
Historical Adapter crops28pixels top and bottom and uses INTER_AREA; joint model uses full image BICUBIC; preserve each trained input convention
Different planner architectures, training splits, effective batches, optimizers, schedules, seeds, and learned parameter sets
Adapter includes20epochs of Stage1 SSL; joint model starts from public LPWM and uses planning only
Different planning epoch counts: Adapter2 versus primary5400/1614=3.346; scene exposure, optimizer steps and compute are also different
System comparison, not an isolated LoRA-versus-Adapter or particle-versus-register ablation
